slides.title: What Happened
slides.body: Existing-home sales fell 5.5% in October to a 3.75 million annual pace, the lowest since August 2010 and below the 3.85 million economists expected (NAR, Nov 12). Sales were down 8.8% from a year earlier.

slides.title: Mortgage Rates Are Easing, Slowly
slides.subtitle: Freddie Mac 30-year fixed rate (%)
slides.body: Median price: $416,700, up 0.4% from a year ago. Supply: 5.1 months, the highest since Nov 2015.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: High rates keep buyers out and many owners from selling. Analysts quoted by Real Estate News expect sales to stay near long-time lows for the next few months. Prices are still edging up.
